title: feat(auth): add OAuth2 refresh token rotation and session caching #12
author: octocat
summary:
Automated Brittle AI multi-agent code review passed for PR #12.
Security agent detected an unescaped SQL statement. Performance agent flagged synchronous I/O. Quality agent verified architectural consistency.

comments.title: Unescaped SQL query in token comparison
comments.comment: Direct string interpolation permits SQL injection vulnerabilities. Use parameterized queries with SQLAlchemy bind parameters.
comments.suggestion:
stmt = select(Token).where(Token.hashed_value == token_param)
result = await db.execute(stmt)

comments.title: Blocking synchronous Redis call in async route
comments.comment: Synchronous redis.set() blocks the asyncio event loop for concurrent clients. Use await aioredis.set().

comments.title: Missing return type annotation
comments.comment: Repository guidelines require explicit static type hints on all public service methods.
